title: skill-adoption aggregate rollup
description: Output of aggregate.py: results/aggregate.json. Pure function of runs.jsonl plus the scenario manifests -- never hand-edited, never a source of truth itself. A third party should get byte-identical numbers (modulo floating point) re-running aggregate.py against the same runs.jsonl.

source_runs_sha256.description: sha256 of runs.jsonl at generation time -- pin this in any write-up that cites these numbers; the file is append-only in normal operation but this still catches an accidental mismatch.

cells.description: one entry per (scenario_id, cli, mode) with at least one run

by_skill.description: cells rolled up by target_skill across cli/mode/scenario variants, for the headline per-skill numbers

adoption_ci95.description: [lo, hi] Wilson score interval, 95% -- chosen over the normal (Wald) approximation because n per cell is routinely small (the default rep count is 2) and Wald is known to misbehave badly near 0 or 1 at small n; see DATA-SPEC.md Metrics.

considered_n.description: runs where consideration.considered was true -- engaged with the skill's mechanism (read it, ToolSearch'd for it, or attempted to invoke it) regardless of whether that reached a clean, completed invocation. Always >= adopted_n for the same runs, since a completed invocation is itself evidence of consideration.

consideration_ci95.description: [lo, hi] Wilson score interval, 95%, same formula as adoption_ci95.

regression_rate_adopted.description: null when adopted_n is 0 -- never reported as 0, which would silently claim a clean result from an empty sample

worktree_dirty_fraction.description: fraction of this cell's runs where environment.worktree_dirty was true -- surfaced per DATA-SPEC.md's reproducibility note, not folded silently into the other numbers
